asset_kind: Publisher-constructed instruction training corpus, not an independent official quality benchmark
data_license: CC-BY-NC-4.0 per publisher data license, not the code's Apache license
acquisition: Historical published original identity reused; current server official-host attempt failed with Network is unreachable, preserved. Explicit existing hf-mirror transport then acquired unchanged bytes verified against original size/SHA256. No raw data downloaded to PC or published.

full_preparation_and_fidelity.repair: Previously omitted original file provenance retained as outcome.original_source_file, never model input or newly computed research feature
full_preparation_and_fidelity.input: Complete original instruction and optional input, preserving missing versus present/empty values in data adapter
full_preparation_and_fidelity.non_input: Original reference output and optional source-file identity

native_execution.backend: Existing BF16 TP2 vLLM/vLLM-Ascend service on Ascend910B2 NPUs; no client model inference
native_execution.profile: Existing instruction-following fallback with native non-thinking chat template; not author LongAlpaca Llama2 weights, training prompt or LongLoRA SFT reproduction
native_execution.sampling_rule: Fixed original first3; independently preselect first original nonempty-input position7324 and its next2 rows to cover the optional-context transport branch. No selection from model quality or failure replacement.
native_execution.budget_boundary: Declared workload-continuation budget, not a publisher benchmark or SFT budget
native_execution.quality_boundary: No separate official held-out scorer registered for this training corpus; no invented training-reference exact-match or benchmark-quality acceptance

fixed_provider_and_research_consumer.boundary_coverage: First/last records, first3 original source-file annotations, first3 nonempty optional input records
fixed_provider_and_research_consumer.boundary: Exact installed provider with explicit new mapping and pinned research consumer verified; not an automatic upgrade of research main or every subsequent wheel

environment: Existing isolated Python3.12.13 client with transformers5.5.4, local matching tokenizer; pure data consumer uses exact installed A9 provider client. No new inference model deployment or dependencies in serving environment.
scope_limits: Six original instruction executions and full12000 data fidelity/consumption, not all12000 model generation, author model/SFT reproduction, quality scoring, production performance, natural traffic or verified per-row membership of every candidate workload class. No observation or research analysis migrated.
